notes:
系统语音：在只会自己出声的引擎上（如联想平板）不再一直显示「正在合成…」、读两段就停；暂停后从刚才那一句接着读，不再从段首重来。
新安装默认用系统语音，不再凭空多出 OpenRouter 和 Gemini；把服务删光后，它们不会再带着 Key 回来。
notesEn:
System voice: on engines that only speak aloud (such as Lenovo tablets) it no longer shows Generating... the whole time or stops after two passages, and after a pause it picks up from the sentence you were on instead of the start of the passage.
A fresh install starts with the system voice instead of listing OpenRouter and Gemini, and removing all services no longer brings them back with their keys.
